pacing.meaning: Authored conservative scheduling, not evidence of a safe provider rate. No retries, burst adaptation, parallel requests, provider substitution or VPN change.

recognized_rpc_throttling.action: Stop this endpoint immediately on first recognized throttle; preserve raw error and remaining unattempted cells. HTTP200 does not override it.

f2_design.request_policy: Boundary/entry first then chronological; one attempt per new key, one owner per header. First missing indispensable source stops later acquisition; all cells retained.
